description: This file defines classes and functions for managing Firefox protocol connections and sessions within the Playwright testing framework, including message handling, session management, and event emission.

classes.name: FFConnection
classes.description: Manages the WebSocket connection to the Firefox browser, handles message dispatching, and manages sessions.

classes.name: FFSession
classes.description: Represents a protocol session within the Firefox connection, handles command sending, message dispatching, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: nextMessageId
methods.description: Generates the next unique message ID for protocol communication.

methods.name: _rawSend
methods.description: Sends a protocol message through the transport, with logging.

methods.name: _onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol messages, dispatching them to the appropriate session.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles transport closure, cleans up sessions, and emits disconnection event.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the transport connection if not already closed.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new protocol session with a given session ID.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a command to the protocol, returning a promise that resolves with the response.

methods.name: sendMayFail
methods.description: Sends a command and logs errors without rejecting.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches an incoming protocol message to the correct callback or event.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the session, rejecting all pending callbacks and removing it from the connection.
